failure.interpretation: Construction/serialization and add-call success cannot substitute for daemon rendering. No accepted UI completion.

ownership.Terra: Prepare bounded diagnostic variants and inspect own-process construction/readback/format handling. No device/build/git by agent.
ownership.Parent: Build/run temporary diagnostic version of existing Plink app under same actual identity/current entitlements; collect native screenshot and sanitized results.
ownership.Astra: Adjudicate actual findings before choosing final production implementation.

variants.name: data-icon
variants.behavior: Existing guarded iconWithData: with validated blue fixture/SFphonebadge PNG; reproduces current failure as same-run control.

variants.name: owned-png-path
variants.behavior: Guarded iconAtPath:shouldSuppressMask:true with identical PNG retained in app-owned local storage until observation/cleanup.

variants.name: own-bundle-control
variants.behavior: Guarded iconForApplicationURL: using actual Bundle.main.bundleURL. Plink artwork control only, not proof of Android artwork.

invariants: Only local synthetic fixture text and own artwork; distinctly label cases.
Preserve ordinary sender identity/categories/current permissions; no initWithBundleIdentifier proxy or third-party icon borrowing.
Class/selector/full method encodings including BOOL checked; Objective-C exceptions caught.
No right attachment, system cache reset, new entitlement, signing-policy change, SIP/permission bypass or helper-app fleet.
Any test-only entry point must not remain in shipping build. No unbounded file cache or automatic multi-notification retry.
Record constructor/readback/submission categories and actual visual outcome independently.
Remove only owned diagnostic notifications/files after observation.
approvedProbe.formatFollowup: If own-bundle control renders but PNG path/data do not, permit one additional same-badge ICNS or TIFF variant chosen from native AppKit encoding evidence; do not claim an undocumented required encoding without actual result. Bound decoded dimensions and encoded bytes; no universal codec sweep.
approvedProbe.renderingGate: User/native screenshot must distinguish variants. Do not infer icon success from getters, serialized bytes or add completion.
approvedProbe.entryPoint: Temporary DEBUG-only process launch argument in existing Plink application, after normal notification configuration, absent from release behavior. No remote envelope switch, persistent preference, separate sender application or identity substitution.
approvedProbe.observation: Post3distinctly labeled notifications once with same synthetic content and no attachments; parent collects one native comparison screenshot. No notification authorization/Focus/settings changes. Remove only probe IDs/files.
approvedProbe.removalRequirement: Remove debug launch-argument/probe wiring before final production source freeze and final package. Keep source of diagnostic/evidence in artifacts if desired, not runtime feature.

communicationDecision.finding: Apple documents sender as person or account. A genuine messaging account is allowed; an arbitrary notification source app/title is not evidence of one.
communicationDecision.decision: No fake account, restricted ad-hoc entitlement, or automatic communication-intent conversion. Genuine communication notifications remain a separate candidate only if actual sender/conversation semantics and valid signing can be established; not a general source-app icon solution.

productionDecision: Temporary diagnostic source/wiring authorized to Terra within current app/bridge ownership; final shipping path still awaits result. No production claim from selector or add success.
